subject.title: feat(apple): copy or save rendered widgets as images from the chat transcript

question: Should OpenClaw accept native transcript-widget image export as a maintained Apple app capability once the bounded filename repair and platform proof are supplied?
rationale: This PR adds a new user-visible Apple application workflow rather than repairing an established behavior, and the protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human acceptance of the product direction.

options.title: Sponsor the Apple export feature
options.body: Accept the platform-native export direction after the filename repair and real signed-app evidence demonstrate the copy and save flows.

options.title: Defer transcript export
options.body: Pause the PR if transcript image export should wait for a cross-platform product decision or another supported export surface.
